Manage loop events

Usage:
  noodle event [command]

Available Commands:
  emit        Emit an external event

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for event

Global Flags:
      --project-dir string   project directory (default: current directory, env: NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR)

Use "noodle event [command] --help" for more information about a command.
